title: Rabbi Tachlifa bar bar Chana
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Esther Rabbah 1:1: he expounded that Ahasuerus was “the brother of the head,” the counterpart of Nebuchadnezzar.
There, on “White [cotton],” he said: they were of gold. There, on “And vessels,” he said: vessels whose form changes within a few days.

notes.text: The Midrash Rabbah — TE digital Esther Rabbah 1:1 explains “brother of the head” through Ahasuerus and Nebuchadnezzar’s similar hostility to the Temple; it explicitly asks how they could be brothers, one being Chaldean and the other Median. The English therefore does not assert biological brotherhood. The 2:11 comparison concerns vessels whose appearance changes within a few days.
The consulted Esther Rabbah places the gold statement in the discussion of the couches of gold and silver. Hyman cites it under “White.”
